tools.name: list_business_checking
tools.description: Compare US business checking accounts. Returns up to `limit` rows (default 7, max 20), total_matches, next_offset (pass as offset). Requested fields always appear (false = not offered, null = not published); a missing unrequested field means not offered or not published. A *_condition value qualifies the value next to it. Give application_url to the user exactly as returned.

entity_types_accepted.description: Must accept ALL: llc, s_corp, c_corp, sole_prop, partnership, nonprofit

has_active_promotion.description: true: only current promotions (rows include promotions); false: none. Recorded for some banks only

min_insured_usd.description: Min total FDIC/extended coverage in USD; extended coverage with unpublished amount goes to possible_matches

apy_min.description: Min best-case rate (apy_max), decimal: 0.02 = 2%. apy_default is the standard rate

integrations_any.description: Integrates with ANY, e.g. quickbooks, xero, stripe (aliases like qbo work)

min_limits.description: Value >= n on any plan. Keys: sub_accounts, free_cash_deposit_usd, free_wires, monthly_cash_limit_usd

rank_industries.description: RANK ONLY, never excludes. e.g. ecommerce, restaurant_food_service, saas_tech

rank_profiles.description: RANK ONLY, never excludes. e.g. early_stage_startup, vc_backed, established_smb, side_hustle

sort.description: monthly_fee_asc, monthly_fee_desc, apy_max_desc, apy_default_desc, minimum_opening_deposit_asc, free_transactions_desc, product_name_asc

fields.description: Replaces the defaults (institution_name, product_name, monthly_fee, minimum_opening_deposit, insurance_type, apy_max, apy_default, free_transactions_per_month). Also: institution_display_name, institution_website_url, institution_type, monthly_fee_waiver_condition, entity_types_accepted, available_states, target_industries, target_business_profiles, deposit_insurance_limit, deposit_insurance_extended, deposit_insurance_extended_limit, per_transaction_fee_after_limit, outgoing_domestic_wire_fee, free_domestic_wires_per_month, outgoing_international_wire_fee, incoming_domestic_wire_fee, incoming_international_wire_fee, cash_deposit_available, cash_deposit_fee_per_100, monthly_cash_deposit_limit, interest_bearing, apy_tiers, rtp_supported, rtp_network, physical_debit_card_available, virtual_cards_available, corporate_card_available, atm_fee_reimbursement, atm_fee_reimbursement_limit, atm_network, sub_accounts_supported, check_writing_available, bill_pay_available, remote_deposit_capture, positive_pay_available, overdraft_protection_available, overdraft_line_of_credit_available, ach_debit_block_available, multicurrency_support, daily_debit_limit, accounting_integration_available, tax_integration_available, expense_integration_available, plan_tiers, promotions, last_modified, last_verified, is_verified

tools.name: search_facts
tools.description: Full-text search of fee and feature details across banks (e.g. 'zelle'). Best snippets per bank with application_url. Terms are ANDed; 'or', "quotes", -exclude work; long queries with no hit fall back to any-term matching (relaxed: true).

slugs.description: Only these slugs; misses go in no_match

topic.description: fees, payment_rails, cash_handling, cards_and_atm, online_banking, fraud_protection, account_management, platform_integrations or other

tools.name: fees_by_type
tools.description: Compare specific fees across banks: each bank's fee rows (amount, unit, allowance, waiver, tiers).

fee_types.description: 1-5 of: monthly_maintenance, overdraft, non_sufficient_funds, account_opening, account_closing, minimum_balance, excess_transaction, atm_foreign, wire_domestic_outgoing, wire_domestic_incoming, wire_international_outgoing, wire_international_incoming, cash_deposit, paper_statement, dormancy, returned_item, stop_payment, card_replacement, foreign_transaction, other

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Detail on 1-4 listings. Pick sections; detail_has shows what else exists. Features are capped; search_facts is better for text.

sections.description: summary, tiers, fees, features, promotions. Default summary, tiers
